clause_says: the sentence offers ALTERNATIVES joined by 'or' and the comparator encodes one limb, so an applicant who satisfies the other limb is rejected by a rule that admits them. TEST: the requirement text contains a disjunction whose limbs name different quantities, and value_spec names one of them.

funder.quote: mit weniger als 250 Mitarbeitern und einem Jahresumsatz von höchstens 50 Millionen Euro oder einer Jahresbilanzsumme von höchstens 43 Millionen Euro
funder.says: the EU SME definition verbatim, and it is a DISJUNCTION: turnover ≤€50M OR balance sheet ≤€43M. The comparator keeps only the turnover limb, so a company at €80M turnover with a €40M balance sheet -- an SME by this sentence and by Art. 2 of Annex I GBER -- is blocked by a rule that admits it. balanceBand is an intake field and carries the €43M edge exactly ('2-43M'), so the missing limb is answerable; what is missing is an OR between two gates, and value_spec has no such operator. This gate is also one branch of the pair below.

funder.quote: Gefördert werden größere mittelständische Unternehmen, deren Gruppenumsatz 500 Millionen Euro nicht überschreitet.
funder.says: 'ALSO eligible' -- the sentence WIDENS the fund beyond the SME row above it, and assessInstrument conjoins every filter, so encoding it narrows what the page opens. The comparator says ≤€50M while its own sentence says €500M: it contradicts the words it was built from by a factor of ten, exactly as innovate_uk G3-02 did. Two further reasons no comparator is defensible: the €500M is GROUP turnover, and turnoverBand asks the applicant for its own (fieldSubject: applicant); and turnoverBand's top value '>50M' is OPEN-TOPPED, so €500M sits inside it and no band edge exists at that number. band_max '>50M' would admit everyone including a €2bn group; any lower bound excludes mid-caps the funder names as eligible.

Every band_max then either admits everyone (the top band) or excludes applicants the funder admits (any lower band). The mirror of wsIG's threshold_below_the_scale_s_first_edge, and it fails the same way.

funder.quote: wenn sie einschließlich verbundener oder Partnerunternehmen zum Zeitpunkt der Antragstellung weniger als 500 Personen beschäftigen
funder.says: 500 has no edge on fteBand, whose order ends at the open-topped '250+'. band_max '250+' is the top band, so it ADMITS EVERY ANSWER and has never decided anything for anyone; any lower bound would exclude the 250-499 companies this sentence exists to admit. The headcount is also counted 'including affiliated or partner companies', which is not what fteBand asks. Quarantining takes nothing away from the engine, because a comparator that admits every value of its own field was never in the engine's way.

TEST: name the intake field whose answer decides the branch. A field that is merely CORRELATED with the branch is not that field: answering it does not establish the condition.

funder.quote: wenn sie einschließlich verbundener oder Partnerunternehmen zum Zeitpunkt der Antragstellung weniger als 1 000 Personen beschäftigen und mit mindestens einem Unternehmen gemäß Nummer 3.1.1 Buchstabe a kooperieren
funder.says: THE BRANCH SELECTOR HERE IS ALMOST AN INTAKE FIELD, AND THAT IS THE INTERESTING PART. What separates this branch from scheme_text_1 is the cooperation condition, and we do hold `consortium` (yes/no/unsure). But `consortium` asks whether the PROJECT has partners; this sentence requires a partner that is itself an SME under 3.1.1(a) AND whose own R&D project is being funded under this programme. A founder answering 'yes' has not established that, so keying the 1,000 bound to consortium would assert a fact we did not ask for. Independently, 1,000 has no edge on fteBand (order ends at the open-topped '250+') and the count includes affiliated and partner companies, so neither branch is expressible even once the branch is known. value_spec also has no conditional operator: one gate, one field, one bound.
